class DenySession:
    def __getattr__(self, name):
        raise AssertionError(f"Database I/O forbidden in fixture run: {name}")


class SearchRecords:
    async def load(self, category, scope):
        return [
            CatalogRecord(product=p.model_copy(deep=True), active=True)
            for p in PRODUCTS
            if (not category or category == p.category)
            and within_scope(CatalogRecord(product=p, active=True), scope)
        ]


def selected(category=None, brand=None, min_price=None, max_price=None, filters=None):
    return [
        p
        for p in PRODUCTS
        if (not category or category in ("keyboard", p.category))
        and (not brand or brand.casefold() == p.brand.casefold())
        and (min_price is None or p.price >= min_price)
        and (max_price is None or p.price <= max_price)
        and all(_matches_single_filter(p.specs, k, v) for k, v in (filters or {}).items())
    ]


class CatalogRows:
    def __init__(self, session):
        assert isinstance(session, DenySession)

    async def list_facets(
        self,
        *,
        facet,
        category=None,
        brand=None,
        spec_key=None,
        min_price=None,
        max_price=None,
        filters=None,
        limit=20,
    ):
        rows = selected(category, brand, min_price, max_price, filters)
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        for p in rows:
            values = (
                [p.category]
                if facet == "category"
                else [p.brand]
                if facet == "brand"
                else list(p.specs)
                if facet == "spec_key"
                else [p.specs.get(spec_key)]
            )
            for v in values:
                if v:
                    groups[v].append(p)
        return [
            (v, len(items), len({p.spu_id for p in items})) for v, items in sorted(groups.items())
        ][:limit]

    async def search_products(self, request):
        rows = selected(
            request.category,
            min_price=request.min_price,
            max_price=request.max_price,
            filters=request.filters,
        )
        if request.brands:
            rows = [p for p in rows if p.brand.casefold() in {b.casefold() for b in request.brands}]
        tokens = request.query.casefold().split()
        rows = [
            p
            for p in rows
            if all(t in f"{p.title} {p.brand} {p.category}".casefold() for t in tokens)
        ]
        return rows[: request.limit]


class CatalogFixtureService(CatalogToolService):
    async def _products_by_sku_ids(self, sku_ids):

    async def _products_by_spu_ids(self, spu_ids):
        rows = [p for p in PRODUCTS if p.spu_id in spu_ids]

def knowledge_service():
    # Empty synthetic index: formal hybrid retrieval uses its BM25 branch; no embedding downloads.
    index = KnowledgeVectorIndex(
        version=1,
        embedding_provider="sentence_transformers",
        embedding_model="fixture-empty",
        documents_hash="fixture",
        chunk_size=500,
        chunk_overlap=0,
        query_instruction="",
        chunks=[],
    )

    class NoEmbedding:
        model_name = "fixture-disabled"

        def embed_query(self, text):
            raise AssertionError("embedding I/O forbidden")

    return KnowledgeRetrievalToolService(
        documents=DOCUMENTS, vector_index=index, embedding_provider=NoEmbedding()
    )
